scope: HOST ONLY; actual certificate-verified HTTPS gateway. No tablet access.
change: Add POST /tablet/v1/management/pair/reject. Require the existing loopback management credential, no browser Origin, and the exact pending pairing ID. Serialize rejection against an in-progress credential approval. Rejection clears only the pending slot and grants no content access.

regression_before.observation: An unwanted request obtained HTTP202 and blocked the intended request with HTTP409. The new management rejection case failed because the endpoint did not exist: expected409 for stale ID, received401.

verification_after.command: Standalone Bun runtime exercising the actual HTTPS gateway, not the test runner
verification_after.tls: Temporary local certificate explicitly verified by HTTPS client; no disabled verification
verification_after.cleanup: Gateway closed and only that smoke's newly created temporary fixture directory removed. No prior state, process, helper or device operation.

original_integrated_runtime_limit: The full extension/compiled-Go/PDF runtime proof is for the base commit. The follow-up change touches desktop pairing management, regression coverage and README only. No claim that the complete integrated smoke was repeated on the new commit.
unsigned_update_limit: Known development-only HTTP update path remains. It does not authenticate the publisher.
